name: Zoth GitHub Tool — Schema-Validated Agent Connector
description: Strict contract-validated GitHub connector for Zoth Studio agents. Validates every request against a JSON-Schema contract before any network call. Supports issues, PRs, and repos (list + create) in simulated or live mode. Token held in memory only.

ai_composable_modules.name: GitHubToolContract
ai_composable_modules.purpose: Single source of truth contract (2020-12 JSON Schema, root if/then discrimination).

ai_composable_modules.name: GitHubToolRuntime
ai_composable_modules.purpose: Runnable tool: validate, buildRequest, run (simulated + live GitHub REST).

ai_composable_modules.name: GitHubToolUI
ai_composable_modules.purpose: High-contrast responsive console: builder, request envelope, response, bus telemetry.

contract.error_envelope: { ok:false, error:{ code, message, request_id?, retryable?, details? } }

technical_hooks.rendering_engine: Vanilla DOM / Web Fetch / CustomEvent bus telemetry
technical_hooks.state_and_offline: 100% client-side; simulated mode with zero credentials; live mode uses in-memory token only
technical_hooks.telemetry_and_events: CustomEvent zoth:github-tool { event, mode, action, request_id, ts }
technical_hooks.integrations: GitHub REST API v2022-11-28; agent-comms file bus (non-authoritative mirror)
